response.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  WHERE t.pointaccarc >= 4.86
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile
)
SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandusage,
       AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_of_group_telescope_counts
FROM group_stats;

assumptions.assumption: The pointing-accuracy filter (pointaccarc >= 4.86) is applied to telescopes before grouping, so telescopes with a NULL pointaccarc are excluded.
A NULL weathprofile is kept as its own group, since GROUP BY treats NULLs as one group; the request does not say to drop them.
The telescope count per group counts all matching telescopes, including those whose bandusagepct is NULL; only the bandwidth average ignores NULLs.
